title: Volaris Hub | OP script keyless DUPE ITEMS
features:
Simple, user-friendly, keyless script for Survive The Island.
Please consider liking this post! ❤️

Offers features like:
- Auto Kill (using hand held item)
- Auto Collect (collects all ground items automatically)
- Auto Harvest (farm resource of choice using appropriate tool)
- Auto Totem (Activates totems + boss totems. Needs Auto Kill enabled to kill them)
- Auto Chest (Opens chests without the need for coins in inventory)
- Spawn Items (Spawn in however many of whatever items you please)
- Anti-AFK (Allows you to grind days without getting kicked for inactivity)


Depending on your executor, the script may not run/load. Please use a mid to high-level executor, or one that supports these functions:
- loadstring
- game:HttpGet
- getgenv
- firetouchinterest
- fireproximityprompt
- getconnections (optional but preferred)

Currently, there is no Discord server, so if you wish to report an issue, do so in the GitHub: https://github.com/flyrbo/Volaris

Please use the script responsibly, like not being blatant, using an alt account, etc. The Script is also open source, so feel free to fork it and improve it as you see fit (credits would be appreciated of course).
